title: @modelcontextprotocol/node
excerpt: @modelcontextprotocol/node Node.js adapters for the MCP TypeScript server SDK. This package is a thin Node.js integration layer for @modelcontextprotocol/server. It provides a Streamable HTTP transport that works with Node’s IncomingMessage / ServerResponse. For web‑standard runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, etc.), use WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport from @modelcontextprotocol/server directly.
